parameters.query:
with x as (
  select $1::text as id
), -- LEARNING-B-BEGIN (generated by Tools/n8n/apply-learning-b.py — edit there)
-- Readiness of «Авто» per bot of the calling install (second parameter = install id, third = gate mode). History = every owner_app
-- send WITH a shown set in personal chats, both channels and the superseded rows of the bot's line. best = the most card-1 matches in
-- any 20 consecutive sends of the history (rolling sum); progress = round(100 * best / 16), held at 69 until
-- the history holds 3 chats and 2 days. matches / total / chats / days describe the CURRENT window (the last 20 sends).
line_bots as (
  select distinct bp.bot_key
  from bot_profiles bp
  where $3::text = 'session' and $2::text <> '' and bp.owner_id = $2::text and bp.bot_key is not null and bp.deleted_at is null
), line_profiles as (
  select bp.profile_id, bp.bot_key
  from bot_profiles bp
  join line_bots lb on lb.bot_key = bp.bot_key
  where bp.owner_id = $2::text
), sends as (
  select lp.bot_key, e.chat_id, e.origin_top1, e.created_at,
         row_number() over (partition by lp.bot_key order by e.created_at desc, e.id desc) as rn,
         sum(coalesce(e.origin_top1, 0)) over (partition by lp.bot_key order by e.created_at, e.id
             rows between 19 preceding and current row) as roll
  from chat_history_events e
  join line_profiles lp on lp.profile_id = e.profile_id
  where e.source = 'owner_app' and coalesce(e.origin_set, 0) > 0
    and e.chat_id not like '%@g.us' and e.chat_id not like '-%'
), readiness as (
  select lb.bot_key,
         (count(s.bot_key) filter (where s.rn <= 20 and s.origin_top1 = 1))::int as matches,
         (count(s.bot_key) filter (where s.rn <= 20))::int as total,
         (count(distinct s.chat_id) filter (where s.rn <= 20))::int as chats,
         (count(distinct (s.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Almaty')::date) filter (where s.rn <= 20))::int as days,
         coalesce(max(s.roll), 0)::int as best_matches,
         (case when (count(distinct s.chat_id) >= 3 and count(distinct (s.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Almaty')::date) >= 2) then least(100, round(100.0 * coalesce(max(s.roll), 0) / 16)) else least(69, round(100.0 * coalesce(max(s.roll), 0) / 16)) end)::int as progress,
         ((count(distinct s.chat_id) >= 3 and count(distinct (s.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Almaty')::date) >= 2) and coalesce(max(s.roll), 0) >= 12) as ready,
         (not (count(distinct s.chat_id) >= 3 and count(distinct (s.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Almaty')::date) >= 2) and round(100.0 * coalesce(max(s.roll), 0) / 16) >= 70) as capped,
         greatest(0, 3 - count(distinct s.chat_id))::int as need_chats,
         greatest(0, 2 - count(distinct (s.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Almaty')::date))::int as need_days
  from line_bots lb
  left join sends s on s.bot_key = lb.bot_key
  group by lb.bot_key
),
-- LEARNING-B-END
sub as (
  select s.plan, s.status, s.current_period_end, s.topup_balance, s.product_id
  from x left join subscribers s on s.app_user_id = x.id
), today as (
  select (now() at time zone 'Asia/Almaty')::date d
), usage_now as (
  select count(*) used
  from dialog_counts dc, x, today t
  where dc.app_user_id = x.id
    and date_trunc('month', dc.d) = date_trunc('month', t.d)
), bots as (
  select
    count(*) filter (where bp.deleted_at is null) as channels_connected,
    count(distinct bp.bot_key) filter (where bp.deleted_at is null and bp.bot_key is not null)
      + count(*) filter (where bp.deleted_at is null and bp.bot_key is null) as bots_registered
  from bot_profiles bp, x
  where bp.app_user_id = x.id
)
select
  (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('botKey', r.bot_key, 'matches', r.matches, 'total', r.total, 'chats', r.chats, 'days', r.days, 'ready', r.ready, 'bestMatches', r.best_matches, 'progress', r.progress, 'unlockAt', 70, 'capped', r.capped, 'needChats', r.need_chats, 'needDays', r.need_days) order by r.bot_key), '[]'::jsonb) from readiness r) as readiness, -- LEARNING-B-COL
  coalesce(sub.plan, 'trial') as plan,
  coalesce(sub.status, 'trialing') as status,
  sub.current_period_end as period_end,
  sub.product_id as product_id,
  coalesce(sub.topup_balance, 0) as topup_balance,
  usage_now.used as used,
  bots.channels_connected as channels_connected,
  bots.bots_registered as bots_registered
from sub, usage_now, bots;
